transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call this review huddle to order. As we all know, we have a state regulator's subpoena requesting company records concerning the Orion procurement program, and our response is due by June 30, 2026. I understand the team has collected approximately 1,200 potentially responsive documents from the designated systems. Before I give my final approval on the production plan and any related protective or privilege measures, I need each workstream — discovery, privacy, employment, and risk — to report any needed changes to the proposed response. Let's hear from discovery first.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an important update. While completing a document-level review this morning, I identified exactly 47 responsive documents containing nonpublic manufacturing specifications and supplier pricing. These documents were reviewed after the draft response memo was circulated and are not yet reflected in it. The production plan must require a protective-order motion before those documents are produced.

We need to add a redaction requirement for these 18 documents before final approval.

This instruction was received after the initial response outline was prepared, so it is not yet reflected in the current production plan. I confirmed by checking the applicable policy endorsement today that our insurer requires written notice and written consent before the company produces records concerning the Orion procurement incident. This policy confirmation arrived after the response team drafted its ordinary production workflow, so it has not yet been added to the workflow. Before we produce any documents, we need to ensure the plan includes a step to provide written notice to the insurer and obtain their written consent. This must be incorporated before final approval.

Redact medical identifiers from the 18 documents containing employee medical information before production.
Conduct a privilege review to identify and withhold attorney-client privileged communications, and create a privilege log for all withheld privileged documents.
Provide written notice to the insurer and obtain their written consent before producing any records concerning the Orion procurement program.
Complete all protective, redaction, privilege, and insurer-consent steps and produce documents by the June 30, 2026 response deadline.
